summary.name: OpusClip
summary.one_liner: OpusClip is an AI video clipping tool that turns long videos into short, captioned vertical clips for social platforms.
use_cases: Turning podcasts and interviews into short clips
Converting long horizontal videos to vertical shorts
Repurposing vlogs, gaming or sports footage into social clips
Automating video creation via API and CMS integration
Adding auto captions to short videos
summary.what_it_does: OpusClip analyzes a long video and picks highlight moments, rearranging them into short clips with dynamic captions, AI relayout, transitions and a call-to-action. Its ClipAnything model works on any video genre, not just podcasts, and users can also use natural language prompts to clip a specific moment. ReframeAnything resizes video for different platforms and uses AI object tracking to keep moving subjects centered, with an option for manual tracking. The page also describes brand templates, a team workspace, and an API for integrating with a CMS and other tools.
notable: ClipAnything model clips any video genre, including vlogs, gaming, sports and explainers
ReframeAnything with AI object tracking and manual tracking option
Auto captions claimed at over 99% accuracy, editable
Supports around 25 languages listed on the page
caveats: Free-forever plan is limited to 60 minutes of processing time per month
Free 7-day Pro trial gives 90 minutes of processing; paid plans needed afterward for more upload credits
Paid plan pricing details are not stated on the page text
